extracted.intended_audience: artists/performers considering taking part in the Edinburgh Festival Fringe and audiences planning to attend
extracted.subtask_description: Information and high-level participation guidance for artists and audiences preparing for the Edinburgh Festival Fringe (festival dates, genres, resources and practical advice for taking part).

rubrics_metrics.name: Anyone can take part in the Fringe
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone can take part in the Fringe.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: We work to make the Fringe an open, accessible and welcoming festival to all. That's why we offer a wide range of resources, practical advice and step-by-step how-to guides designed to support you be part of the greatest platform for creative freedom in the world.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open, accessible and welcoming festival
rubrics_metrics.description: The Fringe aims to be an open, accessible and welcoming festival to all.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fringe Society provides resources, practical advice and step-by-step guides to support participation; the organisation also seeks charitable support to 'give anyone a stage and everyone a seat' and to assist artists and audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ticket pricing display must follow CMA guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Info for artists: CMA guidelines and booking fees (important information relating to how your Fringe show ticket pricing information is displayed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Artists should follow the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) guidelines on how ticket prices and booking fees are presented; see the Fringe information/update for specifics on compliance and display requirements.
